body: This policy applies to the Breathe mobile app. The app does not collect, track, or transmit personal data.
No accounts, sign-ins, or personal information are required to use the app.
No analytics, ads, or tracking SDKs are used in the app.
Breathing settings and media choices stay on your device.
Background media you download or import remains local to your device.
No data is sold or shared with third parties.
Breathe provides guided breathing and relaxation content and is not medical advice.
Use the app at your own discretion and stop if you feel unwell.
You are responsible for how you use the app and any content you add.
The app is provided "as is" without warranties; to the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for damages arising from use.
We may update the app and this policy over time.
If you have questions about this policy, please reach out via the Support page.
